evidence.title: Labour figures uneasy about Healey’s ‘underpowered’ approach to budget

occurrences.checkable_against: UK government borrowing costs, global bond-market data, energy-price data and official US-Iran war records
occurrences.quote_span: The chancellor’s work has been made significantly harder by the global bond sell-off, which continues to raise the cost of government borrowing, and ever increasing energy prices as Donald Trump continues the US war with Iran.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: John Healey

occurrences.checkable_against: UK government adviser appointment records
occurrences.quote_span: Reeves’s chief economic adviser, Neil Amin-Smith, was poached by No 10.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: John Healey

occurrences.checkable_against: UK budget statement and Treasury meetings with bank executives
occurrences.quote_span: The narrow focus of the statement is expected to rule out radical changes to property and capital gains taxes previously mooted by Burnham supporters including the first secretary, Louise Haigh; though reports that Healey is calling in bank bosses next week has reignited speculation of a windfall tax on the sector.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: John Healey

occurrences.checkable_against: UK budget policy documents and Treasury statements
occurrences.quote_span: They also remain committed to what one called a “tightly focused” budget, though they concede that offering voters more “breathing space” on energy costs had become more urgent.
occurrences.speaker: Treasury sources
occurrences.subject: John Healey

occurrences.checkable_against: UK government special adviser appointment records
occurrences.quote_span: Rav Athwal, an economist and the author of Labour’s 2024 manifesto, has only just joined Healey as a senior special adviser.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: John Healey

occurrences.checkable_against: John Healey conference speech transcript and Treasury budget policy documents
occurrences.quote_span: Healey is believed to be minded to accept a slimmer margin, but he gave no indication of his likely approach in his speech, aside from repeatedly stressing the need for discipline.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: John Healey

occurrences.checkable_against: Joseph Rowntree Foundation real-income data and statement
occurrences.quote_span: Alfie Stirling, the director of policy and insight at the Joseph Rowntree Foundation, said: “The focus on ‘room to breathe’ now, alongside the focus on taking greater control over the costs of essentials over the longer term, is the right strategy for government. But families are currently facing the worst parliament on modern record for real incomes and they simply cannot wait three years for government to grip this in the here and now.”
occurrences.speaker: Alfie Stirling
occurrences.subject: John Healey

occurrences.checkable_against: Treasury budget preparation records and public budget announcements
occurrences.quote_span: Healey’s team are committed to avoiding the rollercoaster of leaks that happened in the run-up to Reeves’s budgets, particularly last year.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: John Healey

occurrences.checkable_against: UK fiscal headroom calculations and gilt-market data
occurrences.quote_span: Market moves since the spring are expected to have wiped out at least half of the £24bn “headroom”, or buffer, Reeves had built up against Labour’s fiscal rules.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: John Healey

occurrences.checkable_against: Treasury budget preparation procedures
occurrences.quote_span: The Treasury team have initiated military-style “black boxes” – learned from Healey’s time in the Ministry of Defence – for different teams to work within to avoid accidental leaks.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: John Healey

occurrences.checkable_against: UK government budget statement and financial market reaction on 28 October 2026
occurrences.quote_span: One senior Labour insider said they believed the chancellor was risking a fresh market shock on 28 October if he was not willing to be clearer about his approach to taxation, headroom and spending.
occurrences.speaker: One senior Labour insider
occurrences.subject: John Healey

occurrences.checkable_against: UK government appointment announcement and Treasury staffing records
occurrences.quote_span: Several Labour figures pointed to Burnham’s last-minute decision to appoint Healey as one factor making the chancellor’s job harder, giving him little time to build up an effective team before the budget.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: John Healey
